notes: Queue 15 Unit CY (2026-11-23): the chance that a triggered losing event (GDD-04 §3.3: commute incident, storm-soaked market trip, move-house) actually loses an item. Default 0 — the events are specified and wired but silent — because no source gives a loss rate and inventing one would be a tuning call. The number is set here, by an owner tuning call, when playtesting wants losses to happen; it is never set by a design unit. The rate is a single number for all three events: per-event rates would be three tuning calls, not one. tools/sim/lost_items.py reads this file (WorldData.lost_items_config).
